info: Fire manifest. Each row names one production edit that must make exactly one named test fail.
file is repo-relative; find/replace is a literal substring edit; runner is node or pw (the bundle is rebuilt for pw rows).
A new gate is trusted only after it has a row here and fire.js has seen it fire.

rows.testName: no forbidden construct in any shipped file
rows.why: a color literal inside a string in shipped source must fail the purity scan

rows.testName: REQUIRED_TOKENS, SUPPORTED_TOKENS and REQUIRED_ICONS reconcile with spec.js and api.js
rows.why: a token a spec sheet reads but the library does not declare must fail reconciliation

rows.testName: useButton
rows.why: published state keys must equal the rendered state

rows.testName: a missing required token throws one TypeError naming all missing tokens
rows.why: a theme missing a required token must be rejected

rows.testName: a theme built for the web projection is rejected
rows.why: a web-projection theme carries unit strings native cannot draw

rows.testName: a value outside the contract list is rejected
rows.why: an enum value the contract does not list must be rejected

rows.testName: carbon at 16 uses the set's own 16px glyph; at 32 the base glyph
rows.why: a set's own small glyph must be used at its size

rows.testName: without a label it is decorative and hidden

rows.testName: Icon / default

rows.testName: opacity: the container fades by the theme
